description.value: TBC Indoor Racing is Greater Vancouver's longest-running indoor go-kart facility, operating since 2000 in a Richmond warehouse. It claims the distinction of being the last venue in the Lower Mainland to offer real gas-powered racing, with karts reaching 75 km/hr on an F1-inspired 11-turn track. Private banquet halls, meeting rooms, and on-site pizza make it a self-contained event venue popular for corporate outings and celebrations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms this is a real, operating indoor go-kart facility at 2100 Viceroy Place, Richmond. Phone (604.232.9196) and address match OSM exactly. The website prominently advertises a 'New Pizza Menu' and mentions 'post-victory lunches' and catering, confirming food on site; no evidence for bike-specific amenities (parking, showers, Wi-Fi, etc.) is present anywhere in the text.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Fr-Su 12:00-24:00) does not fully match website hours (Fri-Sat 11AM-12AM, Sun 11AM-10PM); Sunday start time and weekend opening differ — OSM tag appears outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational, publicly accessible entertainment venue with confirmed active website, matching contact details, and 1,261 Google reviews. A touring cyclist may use it as a destination or rest stop.

Café or food on site.detail: Website prominently features a 'New Pizza Menu'; pizza can be ordered for groups during events, and the venue offers catering and 'post-victory lunches' in private banquet halls

wow_evidence: Gas-kart indoor track since 2000, drop-in racing — fun rest-day activity. KW false positive.
blurb: Indoor gas go-kart track with an 11-turn circuit.
